query: What rules and metadata fields will reconcile production-level variability (actor/director choices, era) with script-based coding and how should precedence be encoded when recording and script diverge?

response.query: What rules and metadata fields will reconcile production-level variability (actor/director choices, era) with script-based coding and how should precedence be encoded when recording and script diverge?
response.answer: Production-level variability is reconciled using metadata fields for actor/director choices and era, with script-based coding taking precedence when recording and script diverge. Precedence is encoded through explicit metadata annotations.

results.content: # 21st Century Cures Act: Interoperability, Information Blocking, and the ONC Health IT Certification Program. + (E) Communicating Information About a Health IT Developer's Failure To Comply With a Condition of Certification or Other Program Requirement. + PART 170—HEALTH INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY STANDARDS, IMPLEMENTATION SPECIFICATIONS, AND CERTIFICATION CRITERIA AND CERTIFICATION PROGRAMS FOR HEALTH INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY. HELP 7/23/15 pg 13, pg 27; Available at *https://www.help.senate.gov/​hearings/​achieving-the-promise-of-health-information-technology-information-blocking-and-potential-solutions.*. HELP 7/23/15 pg 38; Available at *https://www.help.senate.gov/​hearings/​achieving-the-promise-of-health-information-technology-information-blocking-and-potential-solutions.*. As an example, health IT developers can consider categories, including but not limited to, those used in the EHR Incentive Programs ( *https://www.cms.gov/​Regulations-and-Guidance/​Legislation/​EHRIncentivePrograms/​Downloads/​October2017\_​MedicareEHRIncentivePayments.pdf*); long-term and post-acute care; pediatrics; behavioral health; and small, rural, and underserved settings. ONC, Report to Congress on Health Information Blocking (Apr. 2015), *https://www.healthit.gov/​sites/​default/​files/​reports/​info\_​blocking\_​040915.pdf* [hereinafter “Information Blocking Congressional Report”]. See HHS, *Examining Oversight of the Privacy & Security of Health Data Collected by Entities Not Regulated by HIPAA, https://www.healthit.gov/​sites/​default/​files/​non-covered\_​entities\_​report\_​june\_​17\_​2016.pdf.*. *https://www.healthit.gov/​topic/​usability-and-provider-burden/​strategy-reducing-burden-relating-use-health-it-and-ehrs.*.
